verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents running experiments in CI/CD pipelines to block deploys on regressions, provides an official GitHub Actions step (langfuse/experiment-action), and offers a CLI for working from a terminal or coding agent. The SDKs and API support programmatic, non-UI automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CI workflow, and in-depth CLI documentation (only a one-line mention).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use Langfuse experiments in your CI/CD pipeline to catch quality regressions before they ship.
